title: A surjective etale cover carrying a representative of the closed-subscheme section
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and i:Z→X a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Suppose the topological inverse-image unit gives an injection G(X)→(i_Zar^*G)(Z) for every Zariski sheaf of sets G [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. Let F be a sheaf of sets on X_et and let t be a global section of i_et^*F, evaluated at the base change of the identity object [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. There are an etale surjective morphism q:U→X and a section s∈F(U) such that the etale inverse-image unit i^*s equals the restriction of t to U times_X Z [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units, def-pc-fibre-product]. No finite-base-change assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09ZF, lemma-gabber-h0, fourth proof paragraph through surjectivity of the union of local representing etale schemes

proof.text: Obtain local representing etale X-objects and sections whose unit equations hold on their entire closed base changes and whose images contain i(Z).

Let W be the open union of their images. For its closed complement C, take the closed pushforward of the constant two-element sheaf and universe-lift its values. Its two constant global sections restrict equally on W. Since i(Z) lies in W, the inverse-image restriction from the top open to W is an isomorphism. Unit naturality and hZar imply equality of the two global sections. Evaluating at any point of C contradicts false != true. Thus W is all of X. No inverse-image stalk comparison is needed.

Use compactness to extract a finite subcover K of these open images. Reindex sections and unit equations by the subtype of K and apply finite-family disjoint-union assembly. Empty schemes and empty subcovers are included by the same argument.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09ZF fourth paragraph; direct restriction/naturality replaces its closed-subset stalk test, and compactness selects a finite subcover before taking the coproduct

theorem gabber_h0_etale_cover_section
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hZar :
      letI : ∀ P : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1),
          (Opens.map (i.base : Z.toTopCat ⟶ X.toTopCat)).op.HasPointwiseLeftKanExtension P :=
            fun P U ↦
              @Types.hasColimit.{u, u + 1, u}
                (CostructuredArrow.{u, u, u, u} (Opens.map i.base).op U)
                inferInstance (small_succ.{u} _) (CostructuredArrow.proj _ U ⋙ P)
      ∀ G : TopCat.Sheaf (Type (u + 1)) X.toTopCat,
      Function.Injective
        (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
          (Opens.map (i.base : Z.toTopCat ⟶ X.toTopCat)) (Type (u + 1))
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)).unit.app G).hom.app
            (op (⊤ : X.Opens))))
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (t : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))))) :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (q : U ⟶ X) (_ : Etale q) (_ : Surjective q)
      (s : F.obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk q))),
      etaleSetDescentUnit i F (Scheme.Etale.mk q) s =
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.map
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).map
            (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk q (Category.comp_id q) :
              Scheme.Etale.mk q ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))).op t
